The Role
We are seeking two motivated Junior Software Engineers to support the ongoing development and maintenance of the Cyber Range Training Centre (CRTC) platform. The platform is in its operational phase and requires continuous improvement through a structured CI/CD process and routine system updates.
In this role, you will work closely with the development team to maintain, test, and enhance the application, ensuring it remains stable, secure, and responsive to user needs.
Key responsibilities include:
Assisting with software maintenance, bug fixes, and small feature enhancements.
Supporting integration, testing, and deployment activities within CI/CD pipelines.
Writing clean, well-documented code under guidance from senior team members.
Contributing to system monitoring and reporting to maintain application performance.
Collaborating with stakeholders and other developers to resolve issues promptly.
This is an excellent opportunity for early-career engineers to gain hands-on experience in application development and DevOps practices while contributing to a nationally significant cybersecurity training platform.
The role will suit candidates with foundational programming skills, an eagerness to learn, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
By joining the team, you will build technical skills, support a mission-driven project, and grow within a supportive learning environment.
